findings.current_semantics: same-token Retry/Merge with no clear and per-page username deduplication
findings.disconnect_requirement: retain a pending epoch until network application is acknowledged, or reconcile/replay it after reconnect
findings.display_cap_behavior: the first repeated response at the result cap retires admission before page processing
findings.late_reply_layers: retire old core route before enqueue, then retire network admission in an ordered batch
findings.network_contract_gap: the current queue can silently drop while disabled and clear accepted work on disconnect; enqueue acceptance alone is not an applied acknowledgement
findings.required_identity_split: stable logical search ID plus replaceable wire epoch token

source.scope: executable tests use bundled proxy; public current-flow review is separate
